spotlight.title: Heavy-Duty Smart Chain Lock
spotlight.body: A 6 mm hardened stainless steel chain and armored zinc-alloy body designed for everyday security. Instant fingerprint unlock, IP67 protection, and a fail-safe mechanical key keep your world secure.

scenarios.title: More Than Just Bikes
scenarios.body: From bicycles to e-bikes, doors to gates — one lock, endless possibilities.

appBanner.title: More Than Just Bikes

supportPage.helpTitle: Still can't find what you're looking for?
supportPage.helpBody: If the questions above don't cover it, leave a message here.
supportPage.step1Hint: Set up and learning in minutes.
supportPage.faq1a: Dry or clean the sensor, then re-enrol the print with even pressure. Avoid moisture and heavy gloves during setup.
supportPage.faq2a: Use a USB-C cable. If the lock is fully drained, connect a power bank to the Type-C port to unlock, then charge fully.
supportPage.faq3a: The backup key is for emergencies. Insert fully, turn firmly, then store the key separately from the lock.
